card.name: Time-period words after rates
card.fires_on: Time-period words that complete a rate, such as day in "per day", "/day" after a mg amount, "per year", "annually" and "monthly". Seen in dose limits and in money or frequency statements.

modes.label: Daily dose rate
modes.description: The word day (or /day) closing a mg amount in dose limits.
modes.example: avoid use of more than 40 mg per<< day>> of omeprazole

modes.label: Yearly or monthly rates
modes.description: Year, annually or monthly in general text about income, cases or bills.
modes.example: the number of cases reported<< annually>> in the nation

card.writes: It suppresses words meaning every year, monthly or weekly, so it stops the model from repeating a time-period word after one was just given.
card.plain: It fires on the time word that finishes a rate, like "per day" or "per year".
